title: Nutmeggy Dense Turkish Provola Icli Kofte
description: A winey, dense, and indulgent Turkish dish featuring provola, double-fry-kfc, and low-glycemic-friendly ingredients, served in a banana leaf vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, diced onion, ground nutmeg, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Add the shredded provola cheese to the bowl and mix until just combined.
Cut the banana leaves into 4 equal pieces and brush with olive oil.
Divide the beef mixture into 4 equal parts and shape each part into a ball.
Wrap each ball in a banana leaf piece, making sure to seal the edges tightly.
Heat about 1/2 inch of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and double-fry the kfc seasoned icli kofte until browned on all sides.
Transfer the icli kofte to a baking dish and brush with red wine.
Bake the icli kofte in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until cooked through.
